title: Chapter 69: Door in the Mirror
html:
The bathroom was dark, and the world had fallen so silent that Chen Ge could hear his own heartbeat. He stared unblinking at the mirror. At midnight, its surface blurred as though misting over. Then a number appeared at its center—0.

The change surprised Chen Ge. He had assumed the number was something left by the mirror monster and would disappear once Zhang Ya consumed it.

The number has nothing to do with the mirror monster?He raised his phone to take a picture—and froze. The reflection no longer matched reality. One of the cubicle doors had turned red.

There was no mistaking that shade. It looked as though the cubicle had filled with blood that now seeped through every crack.

Why would this change happen to the cubicle with the squatting toilet?

Keeping his phone trained on the strange phenomenon, he turned and slowly pushed open the real cubicle door.

The reflected door opened in perfect unison. The real cubicle was empty and ordinary, but in the mirror everything—the paper holder, the toilet paper, the flush valve, even the small advertisements pasted to the wall—was steeped in red.

In the darkened room, the blood-red cubicle blazed like a wound.

Chen Ge did not understand what was happening. He edged forward. The moment he leaned halfway into the cubicle, a strange sensation engulfed him. Something viscous coated his skin, swallowing and compressing him.

He recoiled at once. One minute later, the reflected cubicle returned to normal. When Chen Ge entered it again, the strange sensation was gone. The red door appeared for only one minute after midnight; then everything reverted to normal.

Why did the reflected door turn red? Even the walls and everything inside changed with it.Chen Ge switched on the light and leaned against the window to think. Could that be the mirror world? Did the mirror monster escape from that blood-red place?

To confirm his suspicion, he searched for the details of his first Nightmare Mission on the black phone.

“Seeing the hidden world requires great courage, extraordinary fortune, and a little luck.”

Then, there’s a high chance that the hidden world mentioned in the phone refers to the blood red world inside the cubicle.

Chen Ge reconstructed that night in his mind. Although he had kept his eyes closed, he had listened closely to everything around him.

I did hear the cubicle door creak. And the strange events began right after that sound.

At the time, he had blamed the wind. Now he reconsidered. Perhaps the creak had been the mirror monster escaping from the blood-red world.

The mirror is probably a buffer between the two worlds. The reflected cubicle opened, and the monster escaped from the blood-red world. But Xiaoxiao interfered and trapped it inside the mirror.Chen Ge stared at the cubicle’s wooden door, and a disturbing thought occurred to him. What if I enter the real cubicle while its reflection is red? Would it carry me into the other world?

Chen Ge shook off the reckless idea and returned to the mirror. The blood-red cubicle appeared after the number reached zero. All my earlier guesses were wrong—the number had nothing to do with killing. It was probably a countdown, perhaps showing how long the mirror monster could remain in the real world.

The reflected door looked normal again, but Chen Ge did not assume it was gone for good. As long as the mirror monster failed to return, the door might reappear at midnight every night.

If it continues to appear tomorrow night, I’ll need to remove the mirror; that’s the only thing I can do now.Chen Ge found a heavy black cloth to cover the mirror and left the toilet. After returning to the staff breakroom, Chen Ge pulled out the black phone to check the newly refreshed Daily Missions.

Easy Mission: A normal Haunted House experience should not create permanent trauma to its visitors; I hope you understand this simple theory. Please improve the Haunted House’s security by inspecting the security threats hidden around the Haunted House.

Normal Mission: A single hand cannot clap. A good Haunted House needs a good management team. Recruit more talents; they will definitely help when the situation demands it.

Nightmare Mission: There has always been a second occupant inside your room, wouldn’t you like to meet said person?

Chen Ge was familiar with these three missions. He was conflicted. Nightmare Mission was the best choice if he wanted to expand his Haunted House faster, but after the incident with the mirror monster, he was wary of choosing Nightmare Missions.

I’ll think about it tomorrow; I deserve a good sleep tonight.

Chen Ge had not slept properly since receiving the black phone. If this continued, his body would eventually give out.

Pulling the sheet around him, Chen Ge soon fell asleep.

At eight the next morning, a fully refreshed Chen Ge rushed from his room. He went straight to the entrance of Night of the Living Dead. The spot he had selected the night before had changed: a new passage now led underground.

The black phone sure is effective.

A stairwell had been carved through the ground. Chen Ge descended into the abandoned parking lot, an empty, desolate space where scarcely a single light worked.

That’s it? The expansion only added a staircase?Disappointment flickered, but the vast empty space was now his to shape, and that thought rekindled his excitement. Eastern Jiujiang’s Virtual Reality Futuristic Carnival opens in three months. Before then, I need to unlock as many scenarios as possible, upgrade the Haunted House, and build a park every bit as compelling as theirs.

Back on the first floor, Chen Ge carried the black phone to the main entrance. A new black-painted wooden structure stood between the gate and the entry corridor. Its flimsy, half-open construction resembled two wardrobes crudely stitched together.

This is the Midnight Ticket Counter? It looks so damn crude.

Chen Ge opened the door and sat inside. The space was so cramped that it resembled an uncomfortable coffin.
